name: Cold waves & winter storms
summary: No major cold wave or winter storm affecting large populations
state: No top-tier cold or winter-storm warnings covering a major region were found as of 6 Nov. NOAA's hazards outlook shows no major cold outbreak for the US. Earlier mountain snow advisories in the US Rockies on 4–5 Nov caused no widespread outages.
for_you: Nothing unusual for early November. For forecasts and warnings, check the Met Office in the UK or your national weather service.

sources.title: NOAA Climate Prediction Center — Probabilistic Hazards Outlook

why: Severe cold and winter storms kill, cut power and spike gas demand, as in Texas in 2021; they matter most when energy supplies are tight.
drivers: Polar vortex disruption, blocking highs, ENSO, Arctic outbreaks.

rubric.alert: Deadly cold or winter storms with widespread power or gas outages.
rubric.watch: Top-tier cold or winter-storm warnings across a major region, or a cold wave lifting gas demand sharply.
rubric.normal: No major cold wave or winter storm affecting large populations.
